claim: If hosted checkout is unavailable, Send Gate keeps the free desk usable and explains the next step.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; deterministic intercepted 404 then 500 checkout responses; assert no navigation and the recovery notice

claim: Try three sample gates without changing your real desk.
sandbox: fresh / browser context; click the landing action, then assert the demo: IndexedDB namespace, three samples, reset, and Start for real

claim: A client email draft is released only after a reviewer records an approval.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; approve the awaiting sample with a required comment and assert its mailto handoff

claim: A handoff marked sent cannot be sent again from that gate.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; mark the approved sample sent and assert the email-draft action is absent

claim: PDFs are AES-GCM encrypted before local IndexedDB storage.
where: landing facts, form help, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; add a fixture PDF and assert ciphertext, ciphertext growth, and no plaintext PDF marker in IndexedDB

claim: Accepts PDFs up to 15 MiB and rejects a PDF one byte larger.
where: PDF form help and validation error
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; create a gate with an exact 15 MiB fixture PDF, then assert a 15 MiB plus one byte fixture is rejected

claim: Normal free workflows make only same-origin requests and do not upload gate data.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; record every request during sample review and assert the sole origin is the product origin

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated browser.newContext(); visit /demo, wait for the worker, setOffline(true), reload, approve a sample, and assert the handoff

claim: Exports approval records as a portable JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; download the sample export and assert product identity, three records, and the readable-backup warning

claim: Imports a valid portable JSON backup into the current desk.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; upload a deterministic valid link-gate backup, confirm replacement, and assert the restored gate on the desk

claim: Deleting a named gate removes it from this browser’s approval desk.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; confirm deletion of a named sample gate and assert it is absent from the demo IndexedDB record and rail

claim: The free desk allows five active gates, and Pro displays a $29 one-time offer for unlimited active gates.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; add two link gates to the three samples, assert the sixth active-gate form shows the limit, then assert the Pro price and unlimited-gates copy

claim: A valid license token restores Pro on another device.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; deterministic recorded valid verify response after pasting a token; assert active Pro status

claim: An inactive license leaves the free desk available.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; deterministic recorded invalid verify response for a returned token; assert recovery notice, purchase control, and usable approval desk

claim: Send Gate provides an installable PWA shell.
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; assert standalone manifest/icons, wait for worker readiness, reload, and assert a controlling service worker
